See also: pișcar

Aromanian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • piscaru

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin piscārius. Compare Romanian pescar.

Noun

[edit]

piscar m (plural piscari)

  1. fisher, fisherman

Derived terms

[edit]
  • piscãroanji
  • piscãrilji / piscãrilje
  • piscãrescu

Related terms

[edit]
  • pescu, peashti
  • piscuescu

Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Alteration of pescar (“to fish”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [pisˈka]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [pisˈkaɾ]

Verb

[edit]

piscar (first-person singular present pisco, first-person singular preterite pisquí, past participle piscat)

  1. (transitive) to pick at (food)
    Synonym: pellucar

Galician

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Onomatopoeic, from *pVsk- / *bVsk-. Compare Spanish bizco.[1]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /pisˈkaɾ/

Verb

[edit]

piscar (first-person singular present pisco, first-person singular preterite pisquei, past participle piscado)

  1. to blink (to close and reopen one or both eyes quickly)
    Synonym: chiscar

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

(This etymology is missing or incomplete. Please add to it, or discuss it at the Etymology scriptorium.)

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /pisˈka(ʁ)/ [pisˈka(h)]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /pisˈka(ʁ)/ [pisˈka(h)]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /pisˈka(ɾ)/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /piʃˈka(ʁ)/ [piʃˈka(χ)]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /pisˈka(ɻ)/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /piʃˈkaɾ/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /piʃˈkaɾ/
    • (Central Portugal) IPA(key): /pɨʃˈkaɾ/
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /pɨʃˈka.ɾi/

  • Hyphenation: pis‧car
  • Homophone: (central, southern Portugal) pescar

Verb

[edit]

piscar (first-person singular present pisco, first-person singular preterite pisquei, past participle piscado)

  1. to blink (to close and reopen both eyes quickly)
  2. to wink (To blink with only one eye as a message, signal, or suggestion)
  3. to flash (To (cause to) shine intermittently)
